Stories discussed in this episode:

  • Apple is exploring the acquisition of an AI chip startup to bolster its infrastructure
  • OpenAI says it has seen no evidence to support Apple's accusations of trade secret theft
  • OpenAI's first device will be a portable smart speaker equipped with a camera and other sensors
  • Apple has introduced a new 36-month installment payment option for the iPad
  • Apple has just shut down a popular workaround for purchasing unlocked iPhones
